title: Beatrix and the Typewriter
author: Marguerite Voss
blurb: Felix Dunmore, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the century turns.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
